name: manual_a515c2
claim: Keep one source of truth for access, but only where the platform enforces the app's required users and operations. If the platform already decides who may open a resource and that is exactly who may use the app, do not add a second allowlist, and run as the accessing user so a code bug cannot exceed that person's own rights. If an action needs narrower rights than opening the resource, such as manager-only, platform access does not enforce it, so keep the narrower app-level authorization for that action.
